title: LADM LA_Restriction
description: A restriction is a legally recognised limitation on land use or ownership (e.g. mortgage, easement, land use restriction, conservation order). LA_Restriction extends LA_RRR with rrrType fixed to 'restriction'.

allOf.$comment: CONSTRAINTS: Restriction-specific rules and additional properties

type.description: LA_RestrictionType codelist. Common values: mortgage, easement, landUseRestriction, conservationOrder, publicRightOfWay. Recommended scheme: LADM LA_RestrictionType or national equivalent.

mortgageAmount.description: Monetary amount of the mortgage (applicable when type is 'mortgage')

mortgageCurrency.description: Currency of the mortgage amount (ISO 4217 CodeListRef)

mortgageType.description: LA_MortgageType codelist. Common values: levelPayment, linear, Islamic.
